rows.definition: A provider-reported replacement conversation that closes one fak trace and opens another inside the same guard process.
rows.distinction: The explicit provider conversation boundary, not SessionReset/Recontinue, which preserves one logical session across an internal context reset.

rows.definition: The session-table transition that terminalizes the current fak trace and creates the fresh provider-conversation trace while carrying cumulative envelopes.
rows.distinction: The atomic mutation that applies ProviderSessionBoundary, not the boundary record itself and not SessionReset/Recontinue within one logical session.
